snapshot.scope: Read-only review of up to three official FirstRand/FNB Workday advert records related to business informatics role families.
snapshot.availability_policy: A future closing date or indexed Apply label does not prove a currently open vacancy. Status is unknown where the live Workday page could not be read. Talent-pool advertisements explicitly described as not active are not presented as vacancies.
snapshot.privacy: Public employer advert content only. No applicant information, accounts, application actions, API calls or private data used.

status.label: unknown_live_status

mandatory_as_labeled_by_advert: Minimum eight years of Business Analysis or Business/Systems Analysis experience.
Demonstrable experience in Market Risk, traded risk, financial-markets risk technology or a closely related risk domain.
Experience translating complex methodologies, policies or regulatory needs into implementable technology, data and control requirements.
Experience supporting complex change from analysis through testing and implementation validation.
Proven delivery across business, risk, data and technology stakeholders.
Relevant Bachelor’s degree or BTech in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering, Finance, Risk Management or a related discipline.
The advert has separate Market Risk Knowledge and Required Knowledge and Skills sections covering risk concepts, requirements/process/data analysis, testing and communication.
preferred_as_labeled_by_advert: Practical exposure to FRTB, Basel-related Market Risk change, BCBS239, ICAAP, Pillar 3 or regulatory risk reporting.
Business Analysis, financial-markets, risk, data or Agile certification.
Coaching or mentoring experience and demonstrated potential for future people leadership.
criteria.other_eligibility: Citizenship, age and a specific BCom Informatics equivalence rule were not visible in retrieved content; unknown.
